name: RulZ Level Up Tracker
tagline: See how long it will take to reach your next level.
description: Watches the rate you earn XP and estimates the time to your next level. Switch the estimate between the past hour, this session, your current level and all time.
features: Time to level and an estimated finish time
Allows for rested XP and pauses while you're AFK
Same-level kills and quests left to level, counted separately
Hunters also get a pet XP bar and the time to the pet's next level
Level-up summaries and a history of every level
Compact bar mode, lock, size slider and an in-game settings page

name: RulZ Equipment Tracker
tagline: See the item level and stats in every gear slot, and which to upgrade next.
description: Lists every slot on your character with the item's level, required level and stats. It averages the item level of what you wear and marks the slots most worth upgrading, starting with any that are empty.
features: One row per slot with the item, its quality, item level and required level
Stats and Equip effects in a short line, with the full tooltip on hover
Average item level and a count of empty slots
Upgrade marks on empty slots and your three lowest item levels
Sort by slot order or lowest item level first
Opens from /rulzgear, a minimap button or a button on the character sheet

name: RulZ Auction and Price Tracker
tagline: Scan the auction house and see remembered prices on every item tooltip.
description: Records auction house prices from a full scan or while you browse and search, and shows the lowest buyout, market price and vendor price on item tooltips. Keeps 30 days of daily prices per item, which you can search and view in its own window.
features: Lowest buyout with its age, market price and vendor price on tooltips, with stack totals
Full scan from a button on the auction house window
Also records prices while you browse and search
Search saved items and sort them by name, price or last seen
A chart of the last 30 days for each item
Prices are shared by all your characters of the same realm and faction
